name: Pareto USP
oneLiner: USP is Pareto's tokenized private-credit dollar minted 1:1 by verified users against USDC/USDS and deployed into Pareto credit vaults with a liquid buffer.
collateral: USDC and USDS collateral deployed into Pareto credit vaults (private-credit lending pools), liquid buffers, and a stability fund
pegMechanism: Verified users mint and redeem USP 1:1 against stablecoin collateral through Pareto, while secondary-market holders rely on DEX liquidity

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: USP mints against owner-approved collateral and through the Pareto queue; a 3/8 Safe owner controls collateral lists and emergency/admin parameters.

controls.label: ParetoDollar collateral mint path
controls.capDescription: mint(collateralToken, amount) mints USP only for allowed collateral and only while queue collateralization checks pass.
controls.evidence: Ethereum reads returned implementation 0x7b70FCA01ab3745e24303B56F72296614768c337, queue() = 0xA7780086ab732C110E9E71950B9Fb3cb2ea50D89, and owner() = 0xFb3bD022D5DAcF95eE28a6B07825D4Ff9C5b3814 at block 25166611. Source review showed mint(), addCollateral(), removeCollateral(), and mintForQueue().

controls.label: Pareto owner Safe
controls.evidence: Safe API returned threshold 3, eight owners, one enabled module, and zero guard on 2026-05-24.

review.evidence: Pareto source and direct reads identify owner-governed collateral minting plus queue minting for USP. The enabled Safe module at 0xCFbFaC74C26F8647cBDb8c5caf80BB5b32E43134 identified via eth_getCode (contract, ~29KB bytecode), NAME() = 'Allowance Module', VERSION() = '0.1.0' — the canonical Gnosis Safe Allowance Module that delegates rate-limited spend allowances to specific addresses without bypassing the 3/8 multisig threshold. Safe re-confirmed at block 25296185: threshold 3, 8 owners, 1 module (the Allowance Module), no guard, masterCopy 1.3.0.

notices.title: Permissioned primary market
notices.message: Pareto USP minting and redemption are modeled for verified users; public secondary-market holders may not have direct primary redemption access.

notices.title: Soft depeg
notices.message: USP has shown secondary-market soft-depeg episodes, including daily lows near $0.916 in November 2025; investigate current redemption and DEX liquidity before relying on peg parity.
